band_change_evidence_test.explanation: The two-source requirement passes: The Robot Report, CNBC, the CES exhibitor record, the company website and the NEURA Mobile Robots terms page are independent of one another. The tier requirement does not pass cleanly. The strongest third-party evidence is DIN EN ISO 9001:2015 certification, which is an independent conformity assessment and would ordinarily sit at tier 4 or 5, but it certifies quality-management process rather than any compassion-relevant practice, and the certificate itself was not obtained — only the company’s statement of it. No responsibility report, audited disclosure or independent assessment of Neura Robotics exists. The result is recorded as PARTIAL and the band change should be treated as provisional.

key_evidence: Why it matters: Neura Robotics raised up to $1.4 billion in June 2026, one of the largest rounds in humanoid robotics, and publishes almost nothing about how it treats anyone.
Neura Robotics is a German company founded in 2019 in Metzingen, with over 600 employees from 45 countries and a stated mission of "We Serve Humanity".

The Series C round of up to $1.4 billion is backed by Tether, Nvidia, Amazon, Qualcomm and Bosch. A funding round is not a compassion signal and is scored only where it evidences resource mobilisation.

The one third-party verification found is DIN EN ISO 9001:2015 certification covering development, manufacture and sale. That is a quality standard, not a safety or human-rights one, and it is scored narrowly.
No adverse conduct of any kind was located — no lawsuits, no safety incidents, no labour findings. The gap to the published score is missing disclosure, not misconduct.

notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — SEED CORRECTION, NOT A CONDUCT DOWNGRADE. The published 60.9 is a never-assessed uniform placeholder shared byte-for-byte with nine other robotics labs. Neura Robotics has never been individually assessed. NO adverse evidence of any kind was located. The entire 32.8-point gap is an evidence-absence gap: 34 of 40 subdimensions score at the low anchor because nothing is disclosed. This is the closest analogue in the cluster to the Cerebras Systems case, and it should be handled the same way — as calibration of a uniform seed, not as a conduct finding. The band-change evidence test is PARTIAL: the only source at tier 3 or above with third-party standing is an ISO 9001 quality certification, which speaks to manufacturing consistency rather than to any compassion dimension.
